# Kyphrus
The primary star of the Colossus sector. A stable A-class star with a populated habitable zone.
This star was first scouted by Nanotrasen as a potential area for colonization. These efforts proved fruitful as two planets were found within the star's Goldilocks zone. Those within the sector would know those two planets as [color=green]Asclepiu[/color] and [color=yellow]Merak[/color] respectively. The other two, [color=orange]Fervidus[/color] and [color=cyan]Thrascias[/color], were determined too inhospitable for different reasons.
Around the star itself is a ring of communications-interfering debris that prevents anyone from staying in highly close orbit for long, as it would cause total systems failure within days without proper shielding. This debris is also why Nanotrasen never attempted any megastructure project, as any long-term communication was made impossible.
